crossRefs.note: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good, and the good of their children…
This city will be to me for a name of joy, for praise, and for glory, before all the nations of the earth, which will…
Afterward the children of Israel shall return, and seek Yahweh their God, and David their king, and shall come with…
Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy…
“I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell…
Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you…
True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;
He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to…
Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise…
Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.
In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that…
For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

translations.web: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
translations.bsb: Therefore, men fear Him, for He is not partial to the wise in heart.”
translations.kjv: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.
translations.asv: Men do therefore fear him: He regardeth not any that are wise of heart.
